'''2013 Worlds Day 2 Ryan Jellison DS My Lord, Is That Legal?''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Ryan Jellison]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal|Cor-D-mylordisthatlegal.gif}}
* '''Username:''' sac89837
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
